champion: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ordered_diagnoses: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma

s1.syndrome_frame: Painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis
Grossly edematous glans penis and corona
Tender, firm ulcer on the ventral surface of the penis with overlying black eschar and granulation tissue
Inguinal lymphadenopathy
Fatigue, weight loss, and loss of appetite
key_facts: 78-year-old man
Painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis of 1 month's duration
Asymptomatic 'green-yellow welts' and swelling of the glans penis
Swelling became progressively painful and evolved to the size of an 'orange' over 4 days
Previous treatments with topical antibiotics, antifungal agents, hydrogen peroxide soaks, warm compresses, and cephalexin showed no improvement
Elevated white blood cell count and inguinal lymphadenopathy discovered 9 years prior
Fatigue, weight loss, and loss of appetite
Routine blood test results were within normal limits
Cultures, assays, and blood tests evaluating for viral, bacterial, or fungal etiology were negative
Biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes
PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement
PET-CT scan demonstrated FDG-avid abdominal and peripancreatic lymph nodes

shortlist: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma

shortlist.label: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes with clonal IgH gene rearrangement and FDG-avid lymph nodes

shortlist.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic symptoms, elevated white blood cell count, and inguinal lymphadenopathy

shortlist.label: Cutaneous B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis with negative cultures and assays for viral, bacterial, or fungal etiology

shortlist.label: Mantle cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of fatigue, weight loss, and loss of appetite with abnormal lymph node findings on PET-CT scan

shortlist.label: Follicular lymphoma

s4.champion: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma

raw.champion: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
raw.rationale: The presence of a dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes with clonal IgH gene rearrangement and the specific location of the ulcer on the glans penis, along with the patient's history and negative cultures for other etiologies, support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While similar, it is not specified as primary cutaneous, which is more specific to the skin presentation

rejected.label: Cutaneous B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad, as it encompasses several types of B-cell lymphomas affecting the skin

rejected.label: Mantle cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with different immunophenotypic markers and often involves the lymph nodes, spleen, and bone marrow

rejected.label: Follicular lymphoma
rejected.why: Usually presents with a different histological pattern and often involves the lymph nodes and bone marrow
